title: Poster Prize Awarded at The Protein Society
content: Features and Highlights 2026 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Poster Prize Awarded at The Protein Society 09/28 The wwPDB Foundation made an award for an outstanding student presentation at the 2026 annual symposium of The Protein Society (July 11-18; Boston, MA). Many thanks to the IUCrorganizers and poster prize judges for making this award possible. Gayathri Ayyar Manjula at her poster ' class='img-responsive' style='width: 400px;'> Gayathri Ayyar Manjula at her poster Structure Based Analysis to Distinguish Canonical Enzymes, Noncanonical Enzymes and Catalytically Inactive Pseudoenzymes in an Enzyme Superfamily Gayathri Ayyar Manjula (1), Mary Jo Ondrechen (1), Constance J. Jeffery (1, 2) 1) Northeastern University 2) University of Illinois at Chicago The wwPDB Foundation was established in 2010 to raise funds in support of the outreach activities of the wwPDB. The Foundation raised funds to help support PDB50 events, workshops, and educational publications. The Foundation is chartered as a 501(c)(3) entity exclusively for scientific, literary, charitable, and educational purposes. The wwPDB Foundation is grateful for our industrial sponsors: DECTRIS , Discngine , and MiTeGen . Individual sponsorships are also available. Consider supporting the next 50 years of PDB's spirit of openness, cooperation, and education with a donation to the wwPDB Foundation .
